items.title: Cascadu interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Eddie Locke the drummer talked about carrying Joe Jones’ drums or something. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, man.

ctx.x: He freaked out. He couldn’t move. He was paralyzed. He was paralyzed. He was paralyzed. And of course, you know, I get on the phone after that and I called Emile and I said, “Emile, you wouldn’t believe this.” And I told Emile, I was like, I met two of the guys already. Because Frankie was one and Frankie took me under his wing. Frankie took me under his wing. And Frankie started teaching me. Frankie said, “Look, I want you to come up, this is where I teach up here. I think it will be much better for you to come…

But that story about carrying someone else’s drums, that mentorship, I’m really happy to hear that. Because fellows that were playing and learning in the 40s and in the 30s, that’s what they did. Eddie Locke the drummer talked about carrying Joe Jones’ drums or something.
